mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 46 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are enjoying a Full Moon tonight.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking public feedback for the US 18/151 Corridor Study. You can attend an in-person meeting on November 18 at Mount Horeb High School or join the virtual meeting on November 19 to review initial design concepts and provide input.

We have a full lineup of fun this week. Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia are happening today, while tomorrow features Yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, officers responded to an incident on October 25 where a driver was located passed out in his vehicle and subsequently arrested for operating while O W I.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so head over later today to enjoy this classic treat.
